about.bio:
Civil engineer turned AI engineer. I build production-oriented AI systems, from multi-agent workflows and RAG assistants to the machine learning models and dashboards behind real decisions.

At Healthark Insights I helped build Curie, an enterprise AI platform on FastAPI, LangGraph and PostgreSQL, with Redis caching, Docker and LangSmith observability. Before that, two years at Adani Solar commissioning a 2 GW TOPCon manufacturing line taught me how real systems get shipped.

I am currently pursuing a PGDM in AI & Data Science at Adani Institute of Digital Technology Management, and I am open to AI / ML engineering roles.

experience.title: Consulting Intern, AI & Data Science
description: Developed Curie, an enterprise-grade AI platform using FastAPI, LangGraph, PostgreSQL and multiple API integrations to orchestrate intelligent, context-aware workflows.
Built a scalable, observable AI backend with Redis caching, Docker containerisation and LangSmith for performance optimisation, streamlined deployment and end-to-end LLM monitoring.
Engineered an AI-powered XLIFF translation pipeline using OpenAI GPT-4o, XML parsing and OCR-based graphics translation to automate Adobe FrameMaker localisation while preserving document structure.
